bullets.text: Ambit (SELL): every US$100/t fall in LME aluminium cuts Hindalco EPS Rs4-5 and value Rs40-50/share; Bay Minette contribution delayed.
bullets.source: Ambit — Ambit Metals: HNDL (SELL) - New capacity, delayed earnings contribution

detail.summary: Ambit argues Novelis' new Bay Minette plant will take several quarters to contribute to PAT, using Steel Dynamics' loss-making flat-rolled division as the precedent. Lower aluminium prices also hurt Hindalco's upstream earnings and Indian recycling profitability. Ambit prefers ferrous over non-ferrous metals.
points: Every US$100/t LME aluminium fall: EPS -Rs4-5/share
Steel Dynamics FRP: EBIT losses for 5 straight quarters
Bay Minette may take several quarters to turn EBITDA-positive
Hindalco more defensive than upstream-focused VAML in falling prices

bullets.text: Emkay: LME zinc stocks above 163,000t and Brent above $110 after the Aramco strike; base metals seen staying under selling pressure.
bullets.source: Emkay — Commodity Market Report: Middle East flare-Up pushes oil higher, weighs on gold and base metals

detail.summary: Base metals are weak on a 1-2% equity decline, with Brent above $110 after a drone strike on a Saudi Aramco facility. Emkay expects base metals to stay under pressure with selling at higher levels, though lead is showing early stabilisation on the LME.
points: US dollar index around 101.66; Brent above $110/bbl
Codelco 2027 European copper premium a record $350/t, +7.7% YoY
Copper contango on MCX narrowed to below 7 from 8

bullets.text: Nomura initiated India aluminium ('Beyond war premium') with a group call at 11:30 IST on 22 Oct; ratings and targets are not in the mail.
bullets.source: Nomura — Analyst Group Call - New Initiations: India Aluminum - Beyond war premium

bullets.text: JSW Steel reports today ~15:00; Nuvama sees EBITDA Rs103.4bn and PAT Rs51.6bn, 8% and 19% above Bloomberg consensus.
bullets.source: Nuvama — Result Estimates for 23rd October 2026

detail.summary: Nuvama's pre-result estimates for JSW Steel sit above Bloomberg consensus on every line shown, with the largest gap on PAT.

bullets.text: Jindal Steel reports today ~13:00; Nuvama PAT Rs5.26bn is 24% below the Rs6.88bn consensus, though EBITDA is 3% above.
bullets.source: Nuvama — Result Estimates for 23rd October 2026

detail.summary: Nuvama's EBITDA and revenue estimates for Jindal Steel are slightly above consensus, but its PAT estimate is well below. The ticker in the mail is JINDALST.

bullets.text: Jindal Stainless 2Q EBITDA Rs14.3bn in line; volumes 0.66MT (+14% QoQ), EBITDA/t Rs21,600 beat the Rs18-20k guide.
bullets.source: Ambit — Ambit Metals: Jindal Stainless (BUY) - 2QFY27 Volumes rebound, margins hold up

detail.summary: Volumes recovered from the 1Q gas disruption and EBITDA matched Ambit and consensus. Raw material cost/t rose 12% QoQ, but a 36% fall in power & fuel cost/t offset most of it. Call questions centre on the 7-9% FY27 volume guide, Chinese imports and 2H EBITDA/t.
points: EBITDA Rs14.3bn in line; EBITDA/t Rs21,600, -6% QoQ
Net debt Rs31.2bn; four subsidiaries to merge into JSL

bullets.text: Shree reports today (call 4:30pm): Emkay sees EBITDA/t ~Rs850, -23% yoy and -17% qoq; Nuvama EBITDA Rs7.72bn vs Rs7.80bn consensus.
bullets.source: Emkay — Cement Corner: Shree preview, Nuvoco result first cut

detail.summary: Emkay expects Shree's 2QFY27 volumes up about 15% yoy while grey realisation slips about 1% qoq, compressing blended EBITDA/t. It keeps ADD with a Rs27,000 TP on 16x 2QFY29E EV/EBITDA. Nuvama's preview has EBITDA marginally below consensus.
points: Emkay ADD, TP Rs27,000, CMP Rs22,330
Nuvama EBITDA Rs7.72bn vs consensus Rs7.80bn; margin 15.82% vs 16.38%

bullets.text: Nuvoco 2Q EBITDA Rs4.1bn beat by ~5% on realisation, yet EBITDA/t fell 18% qoq to Rs869 as expected price hikes failed.
bullets.source: Nomura — Quick Note - Nuvoco Vistas (Buy) - Strong volume growth amid sequential EBITDA weakness

detail.summary: Nuvoco beat on realisation and volumes, but management said expected cement price increases did not materialise, so higher input costs could not be passed on. Cost per tonne rose on fuel and monsoon-hit domestic coal supply, and spot petcoke and coal are firming again. Nomura keeps Buy, TP Rs400.
points: EBITDA/t Rs869 vs Rs1,065 qoq; realisation Rs5,936/t, +1% qoq

bullets.text: Petcoke at ~USD187/t keeps 2HFY27 costs high; Nuvama says October trade hikes of Rs10-15/bag fall short, stays neutral.
bullets.source: Nuvama — Nuvama Daily: Sector Update: Cement (+1 more in Outlook)

detail.summary: Nuvama says demand improved month on month in October on easing rains and pre-festive buying, with government capex strong. Petcoke has jumped on geopolitical volatility, so costs stay elevated in the second half and more price hikes are needed.
points: Petcoke ~USD187/t; H2FY27E costs to stay elevated
Oct hikes: Rs10-15/bag trade, Rs15-20/bag non-trade
Govt capex +40% yoy Apr-Aug'26; residential launches -10% yoy
Neutral on cement; JK Cement top pick

bullets.text: October coal generation +25.07% YoY to 20 Oct on peak demand of 260,730MW (+23.7%); YTD coal generation +11.84%.
bullets.source: Nuvama — Weekly Power Demand

detail.summary: Nuvama's weekly power data to 20 Oct shows power demand and coal-fired generation well above last year, with the October run-rate far faster than the YTD pace.

bullets.text: September core sector output +7.9%, with coal production rebounding +10.7% after earlier declines.
bullets.source: CLSA — CLSA India Research | Eternal | Mahindra Finance | India Power | India Economics

detail.summary: The headlines in CLSA's pack report September core sector growth of 7.9%, led by coal and electricity, on a favourable base. Electricity generation growth eased slightly on heatwave conditions.

bullets.text: JPM: FIIs turned net buyers of EMS in 2QFY27 for the first time in four quarters while DIIs sold; retail selling led by Dixon & Kaynes.
bullets.source: JPM — India Daily: India EMS: Ownership analysis

detail.summary: JPM's ownership analysis of six EMS stocks at Sep-26 shows a reversal of the prior flow pattern: FIIs bought broadly, DIIs turned sellers, retail also sold. The sector rose 15% in 2QFY27 against a 5% Nifty fall.
points: FII buying led by Avalon, Cyient DLM, Syrma
DII selling led by Cyient DLM, Avalon, Syrma
Retail ownership -50bps QoQ; led by Dixon & Kaynes

bullets.text: Press flagged by Nomura: mobiles under 30% of festive e-commerce sales vs ~35% last year, with no GST boost; a mild negative for Dixon.
bullets.source: Nomura — India Consumer Durables and EMS: Why festive sales are losing their sparkle this year

detail.summary: A news item relayed in Nomura's digest says festive e-commerce started subdued: pricier smartphones, no repeat of last year's GST-cut boost and cautious spending weighed on high-value categories. A Flipkart release separately says Big Billion Days orders and buyers grew 20-22%. Both are clippings, not Nomura estimates.
points: Mobile phones under 30% of festive sales vs ~35% last year
No repeat of last year's GST-cut appliance boost

bullets.text: Infosys reports today: Nuvama expects the FY27 CC guide trimmed to 1.0-2.5% (from 1.5-3%); options price a 4.09% straddle, IV 39.8.
bullets.source: Nuvama — Result Estimates for 23rd October 2026 (+ derivatives pre-positioning 23/10)

detail.summary: Nuvama's estimates are marginally above Bloomberg consensus on revenue, EBIT and PAT; it expects a guidance trim with margin guidance held. The derivatives desk reads the pre-result rally as in line with the IT sector uptick and the straddle as a moderate-reaction setup.

bullets.text: Coforge reports today (call 17:30): Nuvama sees revenue +13.2% CC QoQ (4.0% organic), PAT Rs7.07bn vs street Rs6.61bn; straddle 5.35%.
bullets.source: Nuvama — Result Estimates for 23rd October 2026 (+ derivatives pre-positioning 23/10)

detail.summary: Nuvama is above street on all lines, mostly through PAT. The derivatives desk flags year-low OI, call build at 1960/2000 and expensive IV, so the reaction could be sharp. Watch points: board composition, Encora integration, demand.

bullets.text: Cyient DET EBIT margin 14.2% beat Kotak's 13.2% on 1.6% organic cc growth; management holds 14%+ into 2H despite wages.
bullets.source: Kotak — Cyient (FV Rs1,350, ADD): Strong quarter lends credibility to turnaround (+5 more in Outlook)

detail.summary: Kotak raised its FV on a margin beat and record September-quarter order intake. Morgan Stanley stays Underweight on relative valuation, saying Cyient still lags ER&D peers on organic growth. For LTTS, KPIT and Tata Elxsi the read is margin resilience, with growth still acquisition-aided.
points: Kotak FV Rs1,350 from Rs1,100; EPS up ~5-12% FY27-29
Morgan Stanley UW, PT Rs982 from Rs820

bullets.text: US 10-year fell 15bp to 4.97%, the biggest one-day drop since March 2023, alongside a semis rout and Brent +3.9% to $113.09.
bullets.source: JPM — JPM Overnight Brief! 10/23

detail.summary: A flight-to-quality rally ran alongside a tech rout and an oil spike. JPM calls the selloff a buyers' strike on risk, not a fundamental break, and expects a volatile tape until geopolitics settle or hyperscalers give a firmer capex message.
points: Brent +3.9% to $113.09 on reported Iran strike plans
Hyperscaler results next week: GOOGL, MSFT, AMZN

bullets.text: BofA sees 100bps cumulative RBI hikes after October's 25bp; MPC minutes show two members most hawkish on inflation expectations.
bullets.source: BofA — BofA India Insight: RBI MPC Minutes

detail.summary: The MPC minutes reiterate the hawkish pivot that began with the October 25bp hike. Two members argued for a pre-emptive move on rising inflation expectations; two were relatively neutral, stressing supply-side inflation.
points: Two members most hawkish, citing inflation expectations
Two relatively neutral, stressing supply-side inflation

bullets.text: CLSA: US$217bn of 12M net foreign EM equity selling looks like capitulation; India saw genuine foreign-ownership cuts.
bullets.source: CLSA — Global Equity Strategy: Paradoxical performance (+7 more in Outlook)

detail.summary: EM net foreign selling is the most severe since 2009 even as EM momentum and foreign ownership rose. In Korea and Taiwan this is mechanical; India and Indonesia saw typical bearish reductions. The 6ppt earnings-yield gap argues for partial rotation from EM debt to equities.
points: US$217bn 12M net foreign EM equity selling
Net selling 1.5% of market cap, severest since 2009
EM earnings yield above bond yield by 6ppts

bullets.text: KEI 2Q EBITDA margin 10% missed Kotak's 12.1% and FY27 guide cut to ~11%; Kotak cuts EPS 4-5%, CLSA upgrades to O-PF anyway.
bullets.source: Kotak — KEI Industries (FV Rs4,000, REDUCE): Margin outlook turns cautious

detail.summary: Revenue beat but margin missed, and management now guides FY27 EBITDA margin (incl. other income) to ~11%. Kotak sees new competition weighing on wires & cables profitability; CLSA reads the post-correction price as already pricing it in.
points: Kotak FV Rs4,000 (from Rs4,400); EPS cut 4-5%
CLSA: HLD to O-PF, TP Rs4,845 from Rs5,170

bullets.text: CLSA: Navratri PV retail -22% and 2W -3% yoy on the GST-cut base, but Sep+Oct to date flat; TVS +200bps, M&M +100bps share.
bullets.source: CLSA — India Autos: Festive pulse

detail.summary: Last year's GST-cut pent-up demand makes Navratri look weak, but cumulative Sep + Oct-to-date PV and 2W volumes are broadly flat. CLSA expects mid to high-single-digit festive growth across Sep-Nov; CV and tractor retail held up.
points: CV retail +15% yoy, tractors +9% yoy, Sep + Oct YTD
M&M tractor wholesales -21% yoy in Sep-26

bullets.text: Havells 2Q revenue +35%, EBITDA +31% (~8%/3% ahead of Kotak); W&C EBIT margin down 360bps to 10.1%; 5-7% price hikes planned for 3Q.
bullets.source: Kotak — Havells India (FV Rs1,250, ADD): A concentrated beat on profitability (+2 more in Outlook)

detail.summary: The beat was concentrated in switchgear, while W&C and Lloyd margins were hurt by raw-material volatility and under-absorption. Kotak keeps ADD with FV unchanged at Rs1,250.

ai_semis.text: META fell 7% on capital-raise language and LRCX lost 11.4%, leading the overnight semis selloff; GOOGL, MSFT, AMZN report next week.
GS lifts Wiwynn TP to NT$4,000 on September revenue 19% above estimates; keeps CoreWeave Buy as funding for its $129bn backlog comes into focus.
